Question ID: ENG2_U05_L02_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.ENG2.V.02

The root struct means build. What does reconstruct most likely mean?

feedback.text: Incorrect. The word parts do not support this meaning.
Correct. The prefix re means again, and construct means build.
Incorrect. This meaning is unrelated to the root struct.
Incorrect. This meaning is unrelated to the word parts.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: ENG2_U05_L02_GP_Q02

MLA Standard: MLA.ENG2.V.02

Which word belongs to the same word family as construct?

feedback.text: Incorrect. This word looks similar but is not part of the construct word family in this lesson.
Incorrect. This does not share the same meaning connection.
Incorrect. This does not belong to the construct word family.
Correct. Construction shares the construct base and relates to building.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: ENG2_U05_L02_GP_Q03

MLA Standard: MLA.ENG2.V.01

In the sentence "The feedback was constructive," what does constructive most likely mean?

feedback.text: Correct. Constructive connects to building and improvement.
Incorrect. This does not fit the context.
Incorrect. Constructive feedback helps build improvement.
Incorrect. This does not match the word family or context.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: ENG2_U05_L02_GP_Q04

MLA Standard: MLA.ENG2.R.10

Sentence: "The committee will reconstruct the schedule." Which paraphrase is accurate?

answer.text: A. The committee will ignore the schedule.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This changes the meaning.

answer.text: B. The committee will destroy the schedule forever.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Reconstruct means build again, not destroy.

answer.text: C. The committee will rebuild or reorganize the schedule.

feedback.text: Correct. This keeps the meaning of reconstruct in context.

answer.text: D. The committee will read the schedule aloud.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This is unrelated.

questiontext.text:
Question ID: ENG2_U05_L02_GP_Q05

MLA Standard: MLA.ENG2.V.02

Which strategy is best for determining the meaning of a word family member?

answer.text: A. Guess from the first letter only.

feedback.text: Incorrect. One letter is not enough.

answer.text: B. Use the root, prefix or suffix, and sentence context together.

feedback.text: Correct. Combining word parts and context gives a more accurate meaning.

answer.text: C. Ignore the sentence around the word.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Context helps confirm meaning.

answer.text: D. Assume every related word means exactly the same thing.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Related words share a base meaning but differ in precise meaning.
